changelog:
## 0.15.7

 - compatibility with TalkArea (fix offset head position)
 
## 0.15.6

 - update Ukranian (uk_ua) translations, thanks to Ch1sho!

## 0.15.5

 - update Turkish (tr_tr) translations, thanks to iFair1!

## 0.15.4

 - fix compatibility issue with TAB plugin's layout feature (ignore fake "slot" player info)

## 0.15.3

 - update Argentina Spanish (es_ar) translations, thanks to Texaliuz!

## 0.15.2

- [1.19.2 - 1.21.6] fix automatic "Before Line" fallback for Caxton and ModernUI not working anymore (regression of 0.14.0)

## 0.15.1

- [1.21.5-] fix click positions yet again

## 0.15.0

 - backport "3Dness": a config option, which can render the hat layer slightly bigger to make heads appear less flat

Example of "3Dness", or Fluffyness if you prefer:

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dzwdz/chat_heads/refs/heads/main/assets/3Dness.png)

## 0.14.2

 - fix translations JSON (oops!)

##  0.14.1

 - update Simplified Chinese (zh_cn), Traditional Chinese (zh_tw) and Japanese (ja_jp) translations, thanks to Internet Yamero!

## 0.14.0

 - add "Auto-detect Name Aliases" feature, which detects responses to `/realname` commands on EssentialsX servers and automatically adds aliases for it (on by default)
 - [1.21.6+] fix "Missing Cloth Config" screen text being invisible

## 0.13.22

- respect "Player Customization" - If you take your hat off, it won't show in chat either

## 0.13.21

- add option to render shadow below chat heads (on by default)
- render upside down players upside down

- add option to render shadow below chat heads (on by default)

add Argentine Spanish (es_ar) translation, thanks to Texaliuz!
detect Showcase Item message sender directly (fix showcase messages not always having a head)

- compat with Showcase Item (just like the Quark item sharing feature)
- fix shared item offset being wrong by 2 pixels
update Russian (ru_ru) translation, thanks to cutiegin!
update Japanese (ja_jp) translation, thanks to takejohn!
allow "Before Name" rendering when Modern UI's text engine is disabled
workaround for Quark's item share rendering being offset when using "before name" rendering

- compatibility with Emojiful when using "Before Name" rendering
 - use @ExpectPlatform to simplify cross-platform logic
update Simplified Chinese (zh_cn) translation thanks to NumberSir!
automatically use "Before Line" rendering when Caxton or Modern UI is installed, as "Before Name" rendering is currently incompatible
fix a crash when server sends click event without a string value
update Russian (ru_ru) translation, thanks to cutiegin!

- update Traditional Chinese (zh_tw) translation, thanks to yichifauzi!
- fix typo in German translation

- add a new default render mode which renders chat heads directly before the player name instead of at the beginning of the line  
  this has the advantage of being less misleading when the message sender is detected wrong
- can be configured via the "Render Position" settings: "Before Line" is the old rendering, "Before Name" the new
- fix an instance where head detection for profile names with formatting codes failed (may help HaoNick servers)

- fix Brazilian Portuguese pt_br translation not working
- update to MixinExtras 0.4.1 (Forge)
add Brazilian Portuguese translation, thanks to chocotoneg!
add Russian translation, thanks to cutiegin!

0.12.8

- fix crash on Forge due to `ModifyArgs` being broken (I forgor 💀)

0.12.7

- fix No Chat Reports encrypted messages not receiving chat heads (since 1.20.5?)
- fix message tag icons not being offset anymore (since 0.11.0)
- fix server knowledge not being reset on joining regular multiplayer server anymore (since 1.20.5)
- fix config being inaccessible on Fabric (1.19.2)

- fix No Chat Reports encrypted messages not receiving chat heads
- fix message tag icons not being offset anymore (since 0.11.0)
- fix server knowledge not being reset on joining regular multiplayer server anymore (since 1.20.5)

0.12.6

- add Korean translation, thanks to kirito5572!

0.12.5

- add Italian translation, thanks to floatayy!

0.12.4

- update Traditional Chinese translation, thanks to notlin4!

0.12.5

- add Italian translation, thanks to floatayy!

0.12.4

- update Traditional Chinese translation, thanks to notlin4!
update Traditional Chinese translation, thanks to notlin4!
add Traditional Chinese translation, thanks to yichifauzi!
add Spanish translation, thanks to zeedif!

- fix crash in case of empty player names (?!)
- allow spaces inside aliases (and remove one liner syntax for multiple nicks)

major rewrite of the last resort heuristic (when there's no sender decoration or `/tell` click event)  
fixes player detection issues with nicknames containing non-alphanumeric characters

- support for Quark's Item Sharing messages
- update MixinExtras to 0.3.5
- always try to get sender name from `/tell` click command (compatibility with Styled Nicknames for system messages)
- fix compatibility with Fancy Menu
- update `ja_jp` Japanese translation, thanks to takejohn!
- update `zh_cn` Chinese translation, thanks to NumberSir!

- don't include MixinExtras on Fabric/NeoForge but require Fabric Loader 0.15+, NeoForge 20.2.84+
- fix mixin error on Forge 1.19.4+
- update MixinExtras to 0.3.1 on Forge
better mod compatibility (e.g. with Clean Chat) by using MixinExtras
fix server-side `/say` and `/tell` commands not showing up on client and erroring (thanks to spelunkhead!)
StyledNicknames compatibility: try to get name from sender decoration click event /tell command

allow server resource packs to disable Chat Heads via a `assets/chat_heads/disable` file  
this is meant for compatibility with servers using custom fonts to add chat heads themselves

- more precise heuristic for slightly less mismatched heads, especially on server messages

- fix missing heads for certain server plugins using "disguised" messages.  
  Thanks Suiranoil for bringing this up!

- option to disable handling of system messages, thanks again to Suiranoil!  
  This allows for even less mismatched heads, but will break heads completely on servers that turn player messages into system messages.  
  You've been warned!
add `be_by` Belarusian translation, thanks to Gazmanovich!

- add `ja_jp` Japanese translation, thanks to co-91!
- fix potential issue with EssentialClient

0.10.18  

 - fix crash due to trying to process cape textures

0.10.17

 - fix layer blending for HD skins
- update Chinese translation (thanks to qznfbnj!)

- port to 1.20
- fix matching name aliases when they contain non-alphanumeric characters
